title: LC-MT363-TypedRepositoryAndOperationSurface
clause: Replace legacy Locus SQL-era adapters with one typed, scoped SurrealDB repository and complete operation surface.

scope.summary: GOAL: Create a provider-neutral Locus repository boundary whose sole implementation is typed SurrealDB. Remove the misleading sqlite_store naming and every direct PgPool/sqlx/PostgresDatabase consumer. Preserve and complete the operation catalog discovered by MT-361, including project/WP/MT create-update-gate-close-delete, dependency add/remove, readiness/blocked/status queries, taskboard synchronization intent, search, event synchronization, progress, claim and execution binding. All commands carry Principal, account, AccessSpace and project-qualified identity; callers cannot construct unscoped raw queries.
forbidden_paths: src/backend/handshake_core/src/locus/sqlite_store.rs as a surviving name or compatibility path
Direct PgPool, sqlx, PostgresDatabase or raw SQLite calls
acceptance_criteria: One typed Locus repository trait and SurrealDB implementation covers the complete MT-361 operation matrix without NotImplemented variants.
The SQL-era parser is renamed to its semantic role or replaced; no SQLite/PostgreSQL naming or dependency remains in connected Locus code.
Every command/query requires explicit Principal, account, AccessSpace and project-qualified target and returns typed domain results/errors.
API, workflow and executor callers use the repository boundary and cannot obtain a raw database handle.
Wire compatibility is either preserved with explicit versioned translation or rejected with a typed migration error and manual guidance.
proof_targets: Operation-table contract test proving total command/query coverage
Compile and source tripwires for sqlite_store, PgPool, sqlx and PostgresDatabase
Authenticated record-user tests for allowed and denied operations
API/workflow integration tests against a real disposable SurrealDB database

surfaces: Existing Locus command, taskboard and status surfaces

enforcement_boundaries: No repository call accepts an implicit global scope.
Administrative migration APIs are physically separated from product calls.
ResourceBroker mediates every product repository operation.
same_project_private_resource_cases: A same-project caller lacking the target AccessSpace receives a non-enumerating typed denial.
cross_account_negative_cases: Cross-account calls cannot create, read, update, search or infer any Locus target.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: API and workflow result projections retain the repository decision and cannot add denied fields.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: A revoked or switched Principal must reauthorize before reusing repository requests, cursors or cached results.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Denied records return non-enumerating errors without existence, label, status, timing or count detail.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Record operation kind, scoped target, outcome and correlation id without content payloads or secrets.
Expose operation coverage, schema mismatch and legacy-adapter tripwire state.
Record DEFERRED-with-reason if repository latency/error watchers are unavailable; never silently skip.

risk_if_missed: Partial operations or surviving direct database consumers will recreate dialect drift, privacy bypasses and split Locus behavior.

risks: An unlisted operation still uses PostgreSQL.
A raw database handle bypasses ResourceBroker.
A compatibility parser hides unsupported semantics.
minimum_controls: Private repository constructors and typed scope.

research_provenance.source: MT-361 operation audit; current Locus types/workflows/storage adapters; official SurrealDB Rust SDK typed-query and transaction guidance checked for WP-017.
research_provenance.selected_approach: A single scoped repository boundary with a complete typed operation catalog and one SurrealDB implementation.
